scenes.say: Seven points split the Formula Two leaders, and the leader might not even start in Qatar.
Câmara has two hundred and seven, Tsolov two hundred. Dunne is third, eighteen behind the leader.
A weekend is worth up to thirty-nine: ten in the sprint, twenty-five in the feature, plus pole and fastest laps.
Two rounds left, so up to seventy-eight points are on the table.
But Câmara is already racing for Haas in Formula One, and you can't do both series on one weekend.
Haas will decide after Vegas who races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi: Câmara or Hirakawa.
If Câmara skips Qatar, eight points are enough for Tsolov to take the lead.
F2 lost Bahrain and Jeddah in spring, but Qatar and Abu Dhabi are on. Racing on November twenty-eighth and twenty-ninth.
Check the Formula Two standings after every race on LapRadar.

title: F2 title decider: Câmara vs Tsolov, 7 points and an F1 or F2 choice
